Job Descriptor

{

  job_id: string,          // Primary Key used UUID you generate. ties this job to its D1 row and R2 object. Primary Key

  chat_id: number,                   <-|  the number assigned to a dm, group, etc. 

  message_id: number,           <-| the number assigned to a message. (only unique in a specific chat)

  time_received: string,   // ISO 8601 timestamp

  content_type: "text" | "voice" | "photo" | "video" | "document" | "url",


  // populated only when content_type === "text"

  text: string,


  // populated only when content_type === "url" (reel / YouTube / blog link)

  url: string,

  url_source: "instagram" | "youtube" | "blog",  // detected in the Worker via domain check


  // populated for voice / photo / video / document — anything binary, already in R2

  media: {

    r2_key: string,

    mime_type: string,

    size_bytes: number,

    duration_seconds: number  // relevant for voice/video, omit otherwise

  },


  // optional, can accompany any media type per Telegram's own model

  caption: string

}
